title: Transportdan foydalanish
can_do: Qanday qatnashingizni ayta olasiz va chipta so'ray olasiz
why: Har kuni ishga qanday borishingizdan tortib chet elda taksi chaqirishgacha — hammasi shu bir necha qolipga tayanadi.

points.text: Qanday qatnashni aytish uchun by + transport ishlatiladi va otdan oldin artikl QO'YILMAYDI: by bus, by car, by train. «By a bus» — xato.

examples.en: I go to work by bus.

points.text: Bitta muhim istisno: piyoda — on foot, «by foot» emas. Buni alohida yodlash kerak.

examples.en: I go to school on foot.

points.text: Aniq transport haqida gapirilsa, by o'rniga boshqa fe'l ishlatiladi: take the bus, catch the train, get a taxi. Bu tabiiyroq eshitiladi.
Transportga chiqish va tushish uchun maxsus fe'llar bor: get on / get off — avtobus, poyezd, samolyot uchun; get in / get out of — mashina va taksi uchun.

examples.en: Get off at the next stop.

head: Ibora
Ma'nosi
Misol
rows: Take the bus to the centre.

common_errors.wrong: I go to work by a bus.
common_errors.right: I go to work by bus.

common_errors.wrong: I go to school by foot.
common_errors.right: I go to school on foot.
common_errors.why: Piyoda faqat on foot bo'ladi — bu istisno.

common_errors.wrong: I get off from the bus.
common_errors.why: Get off dan keyin from qo'yilmaydi.

common_errors.wrong: I take a taxi to home.
How much is the ticket for Samarkand?
common_errors.right: How much is the ticket to Samarkand?

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi. Tur raqamlari — docs/mashqlar.md dagi shkala.

items.focus: by yoki on ni transport bilan to'g'ri qo'yish
get on / get off / get in ni vaziyatga qarab tanlash
«by a bus», «by foot», «get off from» xatolarini topish
o'zingizning kunlik qatnovingiz haqida gap tuzish
o'zbekchadan tarjima: «Men ishga piyoda boraman», «Keyingi bekatda tushing»

final.task: Vokzalda chipta olyapsiz. Kassirga aytadigan gaplaringizni yozing: qayerga, nechta, qachon. 4 gap.

skill_task.task: Kassada suhbat bo'lmoqda. Yo'nalish, chipta turi va narxini yozing.
